text:
Probably taking off from Ton Son Nhut and looking at some rice paddies. Lieutenant Hanna, he was 19 or 20. He was kind of cross eyed. he would look at you and his eyes were cross eyed. he was a real good pilot. I flew with him a couple times. He was killed in 1968 Kontom which is a bout 50 miles south of Pleikeu. Hanna was part of my Unit. After I left, I guess he went onto another unit. I think he was 1st cavalary.

Pleikeu was 1st Calvaries base. They called it the golf course. I put the first radio beacon in there.

Sargent LaFrancois
